Card Q&A.a: It means you can't AA or BB.
Card Q&A.q: What exactly does a "can't AA/BB" effect mean?

Effect: [On Play] ＜Draw 1＞. Then, 1 of your opponent's Digimon can't attack or block until their turn ends.
Inherited Effect: ＜Evade＞ (When this Digimon would be deleted, by suspending it, it isn't deleted.)
